name: Venomancer: Venoshroom mushrooms wear their model and grow inside Mycelial Ring
contract: Mushroom summon 680764 creates creature 506018. Every live client creature-cache capture in AscensionDB
(2026-08-06 to 2026-09-10), the Exiles DB and the db.exil.es dump (2026-10-04) give it display 128263,
spells\Druid_Wild_Mushroom_03Hostile.M2 in both the server and client CreatureDisplayInfo/CreatureModelData,
shipped in the client's patch-N.MPQ. The previous template used 26981, the invisible stalker.
Mycelial Ring 681056 grows 12 Mushrooms inside its 8 yd ring (681291 radius index 14); 680764 places each
summon at a random point (TARGET_DEST_DEST_RANDOM). A random point lands beyond 7.5 yd with probability at
most 0.12, so all twelve there has probability below 1e-10; the previous layout put all twelve on the edge.
Each Mushroom explodes after 2 sec, so all twelve still stand 1.5 sec after the cast and are gone 4 sec later.
Spore 572869 drops one Mushroom below its target after 10 sec, which must also wear display 128263.
